results.title: Osun election: Atiku, Aregbesola storm Osogbo for final rally
results.description: The presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress, ADC, Atiku Abubakar, and the party’s National Secretary, Rauf Aregbesola, on Monday stormed Osogbo to rally support for Najeem Salaam ahead of Saturday’s Osun governorship election.

results.title: SC agrees to Tamil Nadu govt plea to hear Cauvery water dispute early
results.description: Appearing before Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, senior advocate CS Vaidyanathan, for Tamil Nadu, highlighted the deficit in allocation of the river water has left farmers in a perilous situation.
